justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/camera/{CameraManager.java,CameraConfigurationManager.java,AutoFocusManager.java,PreviewCallback.java,FrontLightMode.java} and android-core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/android/camera/CameraConfigurationUtils.java. The package has only 4 direct incoming clients outside the package (CaptureActivity, CaptureActivityHandler, ViewfinderView, AmbientLightManager), but its core classes depend outward on the narrower com.google.zxing.client.android.camera.open subpackage (OpenCamera, OpenCameraInterface, CameraFacing), which is only referenced from this package in the repo, plus PreferencesActivity and other external APIs. That pattern shows a package with modest afferent coupling depending on less-stable, narrowly used helpers, so UD is present.
